definitions.explanation: Each and every year; annually. Used to express something that happens on a yearly basis. Functions as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.english: I go to the beach every summer.
What do you do every year?

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}います→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I see my family every New Year.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}⟦{十|じゅう}{二|に}{月|がつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えます→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Every year when December comes, I think about the coming year.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみにしています→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧。
examples.english: Every summer we go to the beach with my family. The children really look forward to this trip.

notes:
{毎年|まいとし} means "every year" and functions as both a noun and an adverb.

READINGS:
Can also be read as まいねん. Both readings are correct; まいねん is slightly more formal.

PATTERN:
{毎|まい} + time period forms frequency words:
- ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧: every day
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧: every week
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧: every month
- {毎年|まいとし/まいねん}: every year

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {毎年|まいとし}〜に: every year in ~
- {毎年|まいとし}〜になると: every year when ~ comes
- {毎年|まいとし}{恒例|こうれい}の: annual (customary)

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧: last year
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this year
- ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧: next year
- ⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧: year by year
